question: Which Union Minister of India inaugurated largest South Asian film market-Film Bazaar in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anurag Singh Thakur.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Anurag Singh Thakur is the Union Minister of Information and Broadcasting in India. He inaugurated the largest South Asian film market-Film Bazaar in November 2022.**
 
• The Film Bazaar is an annual event organized by **India's National Film Development Corporation (NFDC).** 
 
• It is a platform for** filmmakers to showcase their work and connect with potential buyers, distributors, and financiers.**
 
• The event is attended by filmmakers, producers, distributors, sales agents, festival programmers, and other professionals from the film industry around the world.
 
• The Film Bazaar also features a co-production market, where filmmakers can pitch their projects to potential co-producers and investors.
 
• The event includes selected film screenings, panel discussions, workshops, and networking opportunities for participants.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Smriti Irani is India's Union Minister of Women and Child Development and Textiles**.

 
 
• She has previously served as the Union Minister of Information and Broadcasting from 2014 to 2017.
 
 
 
• Nirmala Sitharaman is the** Union Minister of Finance and Corporate Affairs in India**.
 
 
• She has no direct connection with the film industry.
 
 
 
• **Gajendra Singh Shekhawat** is the Union Minister of **Jal Shakti in India.**
 
 
• **​** He has no direct connection with the film industry.
